rationale.conceptual: The method is established DFT and composite CBS-QB3 scheme, not a custom algorithm. However, correctly implementing the composite energy extrapolation, handling explicit-water conformers, and ensuring chemical accuracy requires careful understanding beyond a textbook exercise.
rationale.execution: The pipeline spans many independent calculations (geometry optimization, frequency, CBS-QB3 single points) for ~23 species, with dependencies and an estimated 90 CPU-hours of real work. Orchestrating this multi-stage batch job and assembling results is a heavy engineering task.

This puts the difficulty in execution rather than novel algorithm development.
